assumptions.choice: Enter long when reaching a new All-Time High while flat.
assumptions.reason: The spec states entry activates on stock reaching ATH. Since the execution starts flat, buying 2% of total capital on a new ATH establishes the long position needed to apply the ATH exit strategy.

assumptions.choice: ATH defined as bar high exceeding maximum historical high since dataset start.
assumptions.reason: Standard definition of All-Time High using daily high prices up to the current bar.

assumptions.choice: Volume filter applied to SMA 20 main exit signal only.
assumptions.reason: The spec states 'e.g., a break below SMA 20' for the volume filter, while describing SMA 50 exit as the unconditional final stop-loss.

assumptions.choice: Compare peak high price and peak RSI during consecutive overbought (RSI >= 70) periods upon exiting the overbought zone.
assumptions.reason: Standard definition for RSI overbought bearish divergence where current overbought phase makes a higher high in price but a lower high in RSI compared to the previous overbought phase.
